what_happened.line: The Agricultural Commission approved the 2021 farmers market regulations and vendor application by roll call, unanimously.
The application lowers the full-season vendor fee and cuts the daily rate with a cap.
Entertainers will be invited but not reimbursed from the agricultural fund, which was given as one reason for the lower fee.
No new market signs this year; existing signs will be reused and social media used instead.
In public comment, a resident raised a horse boarding concern near wetlands; the chair asked her to email him and said he would send the animal control letter.

why_it_matters: Vendors face lower fees for the 2021 market season, which may make it cheaper for small farms and food sellers to take part.
The market is run partly from the agricultural fund, so not reimbursing entertainers is a spending choice that keeps fee revenue and costs in balance.
